scope: Read-only CPU measurements of frozen Viser clean predictions; not a new inference or model change; two selected cases, not population metrics.
frame_indexing: zero-based Viser frame within the 192-frame window; time=frame/30
coordinates: unchanged shared anchored frame, +Y up, metres. Distances reported mm; speeds m/s.

support_proxy.definition: For each foot independently, interval norm(GT_joint[t]-GT_joint[t-1])*30 < 0.2 m/s at joints 10 and 11. This is a low-speed proxy, not contact ground truth.
support_proxy.head_lower_definition: GT head joint 15 height is >0.2m below the maximum GT head height in this window; threshold is descriptive, not crouch classification.

mesh_foot_region.definition: For each native SMPL-X vertex, argmax LBS weight is in (7,10) left or (8,11) right. Use the minimum Y among this fixed region per frame. Includes ankle skin; a foot-region lower-envelope diagnostic, not an official sole-contact annotation.
mesh_foot_region.same_shape: GT and prediction use identical native gender, betas and scale from original identity. Hands/face are neutral in display; lower body is native decoded motion.

local_observed_plane.definition: Actual observed-static input points within horizontal radius 0.25m of predicted foot joint and within 0.15m in Y of the GT foot-region minimum. Select largest 5mm Y histogram bin, retain points within 10mm of that bin centre, least-squares fit y=a*x+b*z+c. Query this local plane at predicted foot-region lowest vertex. No plane or motion is altered.
local_observed_plane.limitation: A local observed near-horizontal cluster, not an annotated floor or scene-wide floor estimate; GT fitted bodies and scan can disagree.

conclusions: The TRUMANS16k window has true two-foot floating near frames119–120 even relative to a dense, locally flat actually-observed plane; it cannot be explained solely by screen projection or GT/scan mismatch.
The same TRUMANS window also has GT mesh penetration relative to this scan, so GT joint height must not be treated as absolute ground height.
RICH16k frame90 has toe/foot-joint elevations but lower ankles and penetrating foot-region minima: a wrong foot pitch/body posture, not whole-foot clearance.
Both selected windows have substantial foot motion during GT low-speed intervals. Matching the given head closely does not imply correct support or crouch mechanics.

head_lower_frames.note: Range may include excluded frames; selection is per-frame threshold.
